# Bulk Crate

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-bulk-crate.md" title="Bulk Crate"><img src="icons/176.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Bulk Crate"></a>

Stores up to **16,384** ordinary items of one type. Its front shows the assigned item and count.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Make this item using the crafting or processing recipes below.

## Using it

Open with Interact or Use. Shift-click to transfer; **Lock to item** reserves the current type, cursor item or selected hotbar item without consuming it. Empty the crate before mining. Filled batteries and tanks belong in chests. See [Crates and warehouses](Crates-and-warehouses.md).
